# Mobile Design Rounds

> Free mobile system design interview case studies for Android and iOS engineers: failure modes, checked against official docs where noted.

## Start here
- [Reading paths](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/start/): ordered mid-level, senior and staff tracks through the case studies and guides

## Case studies
- [Design a chat app](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/chat-app/): Outbox, idempotent sends, WebSocket and push sync.
- [Design a news feed](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/news-feed/): Pagination, optimistic writes, cache invalidation.
- [Design photo backup and file sync](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/photo-file-sync/): Resumable uploads, block-level sync, conflicts.
- [Design a pagination library](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/pagination-library/): Library API, generics, request prioritization.
- [Design an image loading library](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/image-loading/): Memory and disk caches, decoding, cancellation.
- [Design a hotel or ride booking app](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/booking-app/): Holds, time sync, payments, search.
- [Design a stock ticker app](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/live-ticker/): Streaming updates, buffered UI, always-online.
- [Design a video streaming app](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/video-app/): Prefetching, adaptive bitrate, playback state.
- [Design an analytics SDK](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/analytics-sdk/): Batching, persistence, privacy, versioning.
- [Design a push notification SDK](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/mobile-system-design/push-sdk/): Token lifecycle, delivery, deep links.

## Guides
- [Staff-level mobile system design: what the round tests](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/guides/staff-mobile-loop-guide/): How staff answers differ from senior ones, what interviewers can observe, and a four-week practice plan.
- [Offline-first mobile system design: one model, six case studies](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/guides/offline-first-hub/): The official offline-first model applied to chat, feed, upload, booking, analytics and push.
- [Native vs cross-platform: write the decision record](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/guides/native-vs-cross-platform-decision-guide/): A staff-level ADR for a framework bet: criteria, the assumption that flips it, migration, parity tests, orphaned libraries, rollback, and a free template.

## Pack waitlist (not yet a product)
- [Pack waitlist](https://mobiledesignrounds.com/pack/): a planned paid study pack that does not exist yet; no price, waitlist only
